title: crepis taraxacifolia subsp. heterocarpa
intro: Crepis taraxacifolia subsp. heterocarpa, commonly known as Hawkbit, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Crepis taraxacifolia subsp. heterocarpa are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit hepatoprotective properties, making it a potential remedy for liver and gallbladder disorders. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies on this plant species.
